correctness.rationale: The degree partition immediately separates clique interiors, distinguished bridge vertices and connecting path for m>=4; symmetric distance-from-end refinement separates one reflected path layer per round, ending when the middle has at most two vertices. For m=3, degree-two clique interiors can merge with path vertices, explaining k=1 splitting at round 2, k=2 stable erroneous six-cell at round 1, and the k>=3 delayed split at round 3. Direct independent 1-WL code built B(m,k) and checked all 506 combinations 3<=m<=13,0<=k<=45, plus the six-cell at B(3,2). All-m,k correctness rests on the round-by-round wave argument rather than this finite enumeration.
